chunks: And let not their wealth and children astonish you. God wishes to punish them through these in the world, and their souls will depart in a state of disbelief.
ai.seo_question: Why does God allow disbelievers to have wealth and children if He intends to punish them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *Istidraj* (gradual enchantment), where God grants worldly prosperity to disbelievers not as a sign of favor, but as a means to deepen their arrogance and ensure their souls depart in a state of spiritual ruin. It serves as a practical reminder for believers to evaluate success by faith and piety rather than material accumulation, viewing temporary comfort as a prelude to divine retribution.
